scope: All native Lean sources in the eight fixed package roots; explicit srcDir mappings; no proof, bound or scientific status changes.
failure_behavior: REFUSED terminal result; no success receipt; retain actual command exits and stdout/stderr.
success_requirements: exact source checkout and pinned dependency commits
all native project build directories freshly removed
native library builds and standalone orphan modules
standalone leanchecker on every inventoried module
every native declaration in checked kernel environment
all-declaration transitive axiom closure inside explicit core set
compiled unused-axiom, sorry and native_decide controls refused for exact forbidden findings
final source and dependency identity readback
not_established: local or hosted Lean execution before the workflow runs
all Mathlib objects rebuilt from source
all Lean files outside the eight native package roots
parent theorem or scientific status closure

mutation_threshold.required: Every nonstale compiling mutant must yield exactly its intended assertion failure, positive count, zero errors/skips/startup failures; stale cases refuse.
mutation_threshold.generated_threshold: Omitting theorem-value traversal must compile/run and be detected by the compiled sorry control before long native builds.

execution_custody.receipt: receipt.json inside the referenced execution directory
execution_custody.prior_attempts: Preserved complete/incomplete; never reused or overwritten
execution_custody.g0_mutations: Separate mutations/result.json; prior mutation outputs retained under mutations/history/
execution_custody.failure: New current reference is REFUSED with no new success receipt; earlier receipts/logs remain historical.
